newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Gauteng province invites gaming bids.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Gauteng province invites gaming bids.

text.p: South Africa's most populous province, Gauteng, said on Wednesday it was inviting bids for gaming licences, making it the second region to open the gates to legalised gambling in the post-apartheid era.

The Gauteng Gambling and Betting Board said potential operators would be able to apply for licences to manufacture, maintain or supply gaming equipment from Janury 31. The board added it would invite application for other types of gambling licences shortly.
